Game Overview

In Twisted Blocks, the core idea is straightforward: navigate vibrant blocks through intricate mazes, aligning them with matching exits in Twisted Blocks. Combine strategic thinking with clever moves to overcome evolving obstacles. Sharpen your logic skills with each puzzle, paving your path to mastery. A captivating challenge awaits those ready to untangle the twist!
